description: Research used Spanish-language open-web searches in four query records, including country/month, weekly fiscal-reform terms and local/sector terms; no LexisNexis or systematic local archive access. Cities/provinces and sectors remain incompletely covered.
required_followup: Reviewer may run regional/week-by-week searches across provinces, labor, education, utilities and community demands. Absence of retrieved reports is not zero activity.

description: SFM street action (E002), Santiago and Moca candlelight protests (E003-E004), Oct. 10 fiscal protest (E005), Oct. 19 Santiago result (E007), and Cotuí road march/vigil (E006) lack verified simultaneous attendance of at least 50. Oct. 10 reports conflict: contemporary Diario Libre says dozens; SuMundo later reports >250 without source basis resolved.
required_followup: Seek contemporary counts and event boundaries; distinguish event attendance from delegates, citywide effects, or dispersed cacerolazos.

description: Multiple actions opposed fiscal reform in October. Same issue/date proximity does not establish a single national episode. Moca/Santiago Oct. 16, Santiago Oct. 19 and Santo Domingo Oct. 10 remain separate candidates pending organizer/continuity evidence. Cacerolazo accounts describe dispersed household/vehicle noise without a documented public gathering of 50.
required_followup: Verify dates, organization, location-specific attendance, and whether actions were separate or one organized national event; do not merge automatically.

description: Exact CDN cacerolazo URL returned HTTP 403 and was not retried. Other opened/failed source URLs are separately documented. Oct. 5 Listín returned HTTP 406; De Último Minuto timed out with tool HTTP 400; neither establishes publisher denial.
